title: Huru
description: All job-seeker features are free: unlimited mock interviews, voice/video practice, and answer scoring with feedback. 20,000+ questions across 300+ professions. iOS, Android, and a Chrome extension that turns job listings into practice questions.

title: Yoodli
description: Up to 5 total roleplays on the free Starter plan, including AI interview roleplays with feedback. Build a scenario from a job description, then practice with an AI interviewer or focus on specific questions.

title: Aced (formerly Exponent)
category: Partially free — peer + paid AI feedback
description: Free peer-to-peer mock interviews; AI interview feedback and transcripts require a paid membership. Exponent is in the process of rebranding to "Aced" as an all-in-one interview prep platform.

title: interviewing.io
description: Anonymous, live technical mock interviews with real engineers (including from FAANG companies) in a shared coding environment with voice, text chat, and a whiteboard. Check current pricing — reports of both free practice and paid sessions.
